posts.name: kirioni
posts.cooked:
So, I am very excited that soon we will be welcoming some new Heroes and facing new villians in new locals…

So I had the idea to throw a party to celebrate. Here are my ideas, would love to here what other ideas people may have to mark this momentous occasions!

Environment themed tables where people play through a set up scenario with a little story to set it up, and lower stakes akin to a demo game (less HP for Villain) for a quicker game (30 minutes) and people meeting all the characters as they rotate through the tables.

Custom invitations with a costume element thrown in with perhaps some sentinels related door prize, or some variation on the Sentinels Points idea from Gen Con with different prizes…

Love to hear other’s ideas or how they are marking the great occasion!

posts.name: beevolant
posts.cooked:
I love this idea!

I especially like using the environments for table themes (Atlantis, Wagner Mars Base, and Insula Primalis lend themselves really well to this idea since under the sea, space, and dinosaur decorations are readily available, Tomb of Anubis would probably be the next easiest to decorate for… Rook City and Realm of Discord could be lots of fun or super frustrating though).

Depending on your friends, you could get a group to cosplay specific characters (and then bring your costumes to GenCon’s contest too!) and/or you could just ask people to come as a hero of their own devising.

I’m trying to think of SotM food ideas… you could make Smoke Bomb drinks (with dry ice), or make deviled eggs with a little creative use of red/orange food die to make Citizens of the Sun deviled eggs (die the egg white in the striped red and orange of their logo), … themed food ideas are hard though…

posts.cooked:
My fiancee went nuts with this idea. Here are the ideas we had that had some merit.

Haka’s Vitality Surge - Kiwi Jello Shots
Bunker’s Baked Battery - Baked Potatoes, wrapped in foil, with a spread of options for “Upgrading”
Tempest - Sushi! (I noted that he may not appreciate that, because it might talk to him. She didn’t care.)
Ra’s Fireballs - Strawberries covered in sour cream and brown sugar. (I didn’t know it was a thing, but it’s apparently very good.)
Fanatic’s Angel Food Cake
Absolute Zero’s Thermal Shockwave: Baked Alaska or Bananas Flambe, or any flaming dessert.

These other ideas aren’t as fleshed out.

Tachyon - Fast food. (Ha, ha.) Some sort of appetizer. Sliders or pizza rolls might be good.
Legacy - Something All-American is as far as she got. Apple pie is a strong contender.
Wraith - Something rich. Maybe involves chocolate.
Expatriette - She seems like a steak girl.
Mister Fixer - Dumplings.
Nightmist - Fried Calamari?
Unity - Gingerbread cookies.

No ideas yet Argent Adept or Visionary.

We won’t be having these at the wedding. But we are beginning to give very strong consideration to a themed party sometime after.
